answer: Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 25 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Because the thread solution is checked at the mesa gate and logged, the vault audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch therefore pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. The deposit is 65 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
